message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s). Facts: He signed a lease agreement with the real car owner (郭) for 3900 per month. Then he, without the owner's knowledge, pretended to be the owner, signed a lease agreement with victim 马 for 3800 per month, for a year, collected rent and deposit total 50600. Then the real owner retrieved the car from victim. Victim asked for rent and deposit back, he refused.

Thus he used false contract (pretending to be owner) to obtain money. This is contract fraud (合同诈骗). Also possibly fraud (诈骗) but correction says if false contract used, classify as 合同诈骗 rather than generic 诈骗. Also possibly "诈骗" is generic but we should use 合同诈骗.

Any other crimes? Possibly "非法占有" is element of fraud. No mention of forging seals. He didn't forge a seal, just misrepresented. So crime: 合同诈骗.

Thus output: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>
